about: Judge accuracy eval (ARCHITECTURE §13.3). Each case is an answer an AI could give, labelled by hand: is the product named, and at what position in the list of products the answer gives (null when it isn't in a list). These are written to cover the hard cases; real pasted answers go in evals/judge/private/ (not committed). Label by reading the answer, never by copying the judge's output.
